candidates.claim: SSH on sw-ot-01 line vty 0 4 has no access-class, so it is not restricted to the MGMT subnet 10.10.99.0/24 as the management policy requires.
candidates.remediation: Reapply access-class VTY_MGMT on line vty 0 4 of sw-ot-01.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits TCP/443 from any source to fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2, and fw-01 has the HTTP server enabled globally, so HTTPS toward the firewall is not restricted to MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit for TCP/443 to 203.0.113.2 or restrict it to MGMT sources, and confirm the fw-01 HTTP server is limited to the mgmt interface.

candidates.claim: The approved baseline has access-class VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 line vty 0 4, and the current configuration no longer has it.
candidates.remediation: Restore access-class VTY_MGMT on line vty 0 4 of sw-ot-01 or formally approve the removal.
